display_title: I Became the Emperor's Hated Male Concubine
description:
Despite his flower-like beauty, Yeon Hwa-Un was hated by all for his foul temper and wicked deeds. The day he fell into a pond, a guard died trying to save him. When Hwa-Un awoke, the spirit of that guard, Ha-Un, had entered his body. Ha-Un, possessing the concubine, tells the palace staff he will change, but no one believes him. Emperor Lee Han, who harbors the utmost distrust for Hwa-Un, becomes even more prickly, unable to fathom Ha-Un's true nature, who is now the complete opposite of his former self...

*"You little rascal... What are you up to this time? Yes. I'll fall for your clever trick once."*

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
